mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) may potentiate perphenazine's neurotoxic and ototoxic effects; both agents can cause CNS depression and perphenazine may mask symptoms of aminoglycoside toxicity.
action: Monitor for ototoxicity (hearing loss, tinnitus), vestibular dysfunction, and enhanced CNS depression; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
